title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. translated_title: 具有联合状态-动作生成的人形机器人世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 人形机器人是通用操作的一个有前景的平台。近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略直接从多模态观测中学习动作，而世界动作模型（WAM）进一步引入未来视觉预测来改进动作生成。然而，在分层的人形机器人系统中，VLA和WAM策略输出的是参考动作，这些动作随后需要通过全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡和接触来实现。这种分层结构产生了动作-执行鸿沟：策略生成的参考动作可能与机器人实际实现的运动存在差异。在没有显式建模已实现身体状态的情况下，未来视觉预测必须同时解释场景演化以及参考动作与实际执行运动之间的差异，这使得难以将动作与其物理结果关联起来。我们提出了HWAM，一种具有联合状态-动作生成的人形机器人世界动作模型……
tldr: 提出了HWAM——一种通过联合生成机器人状态与动作来弥合分层人形机器人系统中参考动作与实际执行运动之间动作-执行鸿沟的世界动作模型。
en_tdlr: HWAM is a Humanoid World Action Model that bridges the action-execution gap in hierarchical humanoid systems by jointly generating robot states and actions.
